title: 5.02 / Physical Directories
slide_intent: Select identity contrast in context so a visitor can locate the store among competing signs.
strategic_value: A readable mark can maintain Spectrum’s visibility on both light and dark tenant boards.
demonstration: Two rows compare logo variants on photographed directory panels; red diagonals identify the weak-contrast choices.
practical_value: Choose the variant from the physical background rather than from a preferred logo color alone.

content_islands.name: Heading and explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left and physical-directory guidance above the comparisons.

content_islands.name: Light-surface comparison
content_islands.spec: Pair two light directory photographs across the upper row; cross out the reverse logo.

content_islands.name: Dark-surface comparison
content_islands.spec: Pair two dark directory photographs below; cross out the deep-blue logo.

ingredient.name: Directory logo contrast
ingredient.role: Help visitors distinguish the Spectrum tenant listing.
ingredient.application: Use the Deep Blue logo on a white or light surface and the Reverse logo on a dark surface.
ingredient.scope: Physical mall directories shown in this 2017 guide.
